title: Communist Handbills In Japanese Found Off Scott Road On Jan. 4

page_data.en:
copy
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5638
Headquarters, S. 2
Date 8 / 2 / 35
January 20, 1934

Communist handbills in Japanese.

D. S. Umemoto.

I forward herewith a summarized translation of two communist
handbills in Japanese which were found by a Japanese on January 4
in Chinese territory off Scott Road and was later handed to the
Japanese Consulate Police. As there is only one copy of each kind,
I have obtained photographic copies.

CeP
D.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别支部登记处。
编号 D 5638
总部，S. 2
日期 1935年2月8日

1934年1月20日

日文共产主义传单。

D. S. Umemoto（梅本）。

兹随函附上两份日文共产主义传单的摘要译文，这些传单于1月4日由一名日本人在斯科特路（Scott Road）以外的中国地界发现，随后移交给日本领事馆警察。由于每种传单仅有一份原件，我已获取了照片副本。

CeP
D.

特别支部主管警官。

page_data.en:
Summarized translation of a handbill in Japanese issued by the
Shanghai Anti-War Storming Party and addressed to sailors of
the Japanese Third Fleet and the Japanese Naval Landing Party
which was found in Chinese territory off Scott Road on January
4, 1934.
--------------------------
To sailors of the Japanese Third Fleet and the Naval Landing
Party.

Start rioting and hold anti-war demonstrations on the
anniversary of the "Three L Day". You should co-operate with
the Red Army which is fighting the Chinese Militarists and
struggling against invasion by Japan.

The Japanese Imperial Government has invaded Manchuria
at the cost of more than 100,000 lives of our brethren. We
have derived no benefit from the invasion and only the Mitsui,
the Mitsubishi and other capitalists have been the gainers.
They are now planning an aggression against Southern China
with Shanghai as the base of operations. They have despatched
200,000 soldiers to Manchuria and several tens of thousands of
other soldiers equipped with poison gas, machine guns and
aeroplanes are awaiting an outbreak of war near Shanghai.

For whom are you fighting? Why do you kill your Chinese
brethren? Are not your parents, wives and children starving
in Japan? Should you be killed, the Emperor will not look
after your family forever. Think of your family who are
awaiting your return and who are being oppressed by landlords
and moneylenders until they are on the verge of starvation.
The Red Army of the Chinese Soviet Government is prepared to
co-operate with you for the overthrow of the Kuomintang and
the Japanese ruling class. You drill from morning till night
but receive less than 20 sen a day. You are not permitted to
go ashore. Is not this slavery? Hold meetings in your
barracks or on ships and appoint representatives to lodge a
protest with officers and to demand an increase of your wages
to Yen 1.50 per diem. Object to all acts of aggression against
China and oppose drills.
page_data.zh:
1934年1月4日在斯科特路（Scott Road）以外的中国地界发现的、由上海反战突击党印发并致日本第三舰队水兵及日本海军陆战队队员的日文传单的摘要译文。
--------------------------
致日本第三舰队水兵及海军陆战队队员。

在“三L日”纪念日发动暴动并举行反战示威。你们应与正在与中国军阀作战并抗击日本侵略的红军合作。

日本帝国政府以牺牲我们十万多名同胞的生命为代价入侵了满洲。我们从入侵中未获任何利益，只有三井、三菱及其他资本家从中获利。他们现在正计划以上海为行动基地侵略华南。他们已向满洲派遣了20万士兵，另有数万名配备毒气、机枪和飞机的士兵正在上海附近待命，伺机发动战争。

你们在为谁而战？为何要杀害你们的中国兄弟？难道你们的父母、妻儿不在日本挨饿吗？如果你们阵亡，天皇不会永远照顾你们的家庭。想想那些等待你们归来、正受地主和高利贷者压迫直至濒临饿死的家人吧。中华苏维埃政府的红军准备与你们合作，推翻国民党和日本统治阶级。你们从早到晚操练，但每天所得不足20钱（sen）。你们不被允许上岸。这难道不是奴役吗？在军营或舰船上举行会议，指派代表向军官提出抗议，并要求将工资增加至每日1.50日元。反对一切侵华行径，抵制操练。

page_data.en:
The week from January 15 to January 21 (the anniversary
of the "Three L Day") should be observed by holding
demonstrations and riotings.
Overthrow the Kuomintang and all Imperialists who are
attacking the Chinese Soviet.
Demand an increase of wages to Yen 1.50 per diem and
better treatment.
Join the Storming Party.
Protest the Chinese Communist Party and the Red Army.
Long live the "Three L Day".
Shanghai Anti-War Storming Party.
page_data.zh:
1月15日至1月21日（“三L日”纪念日）这一周应通过举行示威和暴动来纪念。
推翻国民党及所有进攻中华苏维埃的帝国主义者。
要求将工资增加至每日1.50日元并改善待遇。
加入突击党。
声援中国共产党和红军。
“三L日”万岁。
上海反战突击党。

page_data.en:
Summarised translation of a communist handbill dated
January 4, 1934, purporting to emanate from the Shanghai Anti-
War Steering Party and addressed to the Sailors of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party and Labouring masses in Shanghai, which was
found in Chinese territory off Scott Road on January 4, 1934.

-------------------------

The week from January 15 to 21, which is the anniversary
of the "Three L. Day", is approaching. Let us hold demonstra-
tions and strikes to protest against the white terror and to
oppose war.

Hold meetings in barracks, on warships, on merchant
steamers, in schools and in buildings and prepare for the
struggle.

To the sailors of the Naval Landing Party and the working
masses! The imperialists throughout the world are intensifying
their preparations for an attack on the Soviet Union and for
the partition of China. The most offensive of these imperialists
is the Japanese Government which has passed a budget of Yen
2,200,000,000 for military expenditure. The farmers and
labourers in Japan are being burdened with heavy taxes.

The Chinese Kuomintang militarist Chiang Kai Shek has
sold Manchuria to the Japanese imperialists, and he is now
working as the tool of the foreign Powers. He has imprisoned
and killed members of the C.C.P. and anti-imperialists who
were engaged in a struggle for the welfare of the people.

To all anti-imperialists, sailors and labourers on all
vessels! The Japanese imperialists are preparing for a second
war of plunder. We should, therefore, observe the anniversary
of the "Three L. Day" by rising and opposing the white terror
of the ruling class.

January 15 is the anniversary of the murder of Rosa
Luxemburg and Karl Liebknecht, two German anti-imperialists.
On January 17 Wong, a Chinese Communist, was shot at Changsha
by the Chinese militarists. January 21 is the day on which
Lenin died. This is a week which should not be forgotten by
the working masses.
page_data.zh:
据称由上海反战指导党（Steering Party）印发、致日本海军陆战队队员及上海劳工大众的共产主义传单的摘要译文，日期为1934年1月4日，该传单于1934年1月4日在斯科特路（Scott Road）以外的中国地界被发现。

-------------------------

1月15日至21日这一周即将来临，这是“三L日”的纪念日。让我们举行示威和罢工，以抗议白色恐怖并反对战争。

在军营、战舰、商船、学校和建筑物内举行会议，为斗争做好准备。

致海军陆战队队员和广大劳工群众！全世界的帝国主义者正在加紧准备进攻苏联和瓜分中国。这些帝国主义者中最具攻击性的是日本政府，其已通过22亿日元的军事预算。日本的农民和劳工正承受着沉重的税负。

中国国民党军阀蒋介石已将满洲出卖给日本帝国主义者，他现在充当列强的工具。他监禁并杀害了为民众福利而斗争的中国共产党成员和反帝国主义者。

致所有反帝国主义者、各船只上的水手和劳工！日本帝国主义者正准备进行第二次掠夺战争。因此，我们应该通过起义并反对统治阶级的白色恐怖来纪念“三L日”。

1月15日是两位德国反帝国主义者罗莎·卢森堡（Rosa Luxemburg）和卡尔·李卜克内西（Karl Liebknecht）遇害的纪念日。1月17日，中国共产党人王（Wong）在长沙被中国军阀枪杀。1月21日是列宁逝世的日子。这是广大劳工群众不应忘记的一周。

page_data.en:
2.

Only the capitalists and militarists will be the gainers
in a war. You may win the war but out of the victory will come
unemployment, starvation and death. Peace and freedom can only
be obtained by co-operation with your brothers of the Chinese
Soviet. Hold meetings in factories and submit complaints.

Drive out all imperialists who are planning the partition
of China.

Overthrow the Japanese imperialists who are preparing for
aggression against the Soviet Union.

Overthrow the Fascists under Chiang Kai Shek who is
betraying the Chinese masses by working as the tool
of the foriegn imperialists.

Oppose military drill and labour.

Agitate for better food for sailors and an increase
of wages to Yen 1.50 per diem.

Overthrow the Japanese Residents Corporation and the
Ex-Soldiers Association.

Protest the Chinese Communist Party, the Red Army and
the Anti-imperialist League.

Establish the independence of Korea, Formosa, Annam
and China.

Organize storming parties in barracks, on warships
and merchants vessels, in schools and in factories.

Long live the "Three L Day".

The Shanghai Anti-War Storming Party.
January 4, 1934.
page_data.zh:
2.

只有资本家和军阀才会从战争中获利。你们也许能赢得战争，但胜利带来的将是失业、饥饿和死亡。只有与中华苏维埃的兄弟们合作，才能获得和平与自由。在工厂举行会议并提交诉状。

驱逐所有策划瓜分中国的帝国主义者。

推翻正准备侵略苏联的日本帝国主义者。

推翻蒋介石旗下的法西斯分子，蒋介石充当外国帝国主义者的工具，背叛了中国大众。

反对军事操练和劳役。

鼓动改善水手伙食并将工资增加至每日1.50日元。

推翻日本居留民团和退伍军人协会。

声援中国共产党、红军和反帝同盟。

实现朝鲜、台湾、安南和中国的独立。

在军营、战舰和商船、学校及工厂组织突击队。

“三L日”万岁。

上海反战突击党。
1934年1月4日。
